items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: they waited until I stopped playing, and Red had been playing for about an hour to come in there and raid the place anyhow.

ctx.x: So soon they got back, and they had ten policemen hired there to keep order. He got two brothers out there called the Foreman(?) Brothers. Said, "They can fire any of them policemen they want, but they can't fire no Foreman(?) Brothers. They got to keep them Foreman(?) Brothers there. They got to keep them there. That's what I tell ...(?)."

When they came... They got there a little before the early band started, the first band, and I told them about it. So the first thing the colored manager said was, "Oh, they can't tell us... We paid them policemen out of our pocket. Paid them ourselves. They can't tell us who to fire and who to keep." I said, "Well, I can tell you what the man said. He said if we keep the White folks out of here we're all right." That happened on the Saturday night. We had to let it run all week until the next Saturday; they…
Even though there were no White people there.
